title: The Callahan: Pickleball, Sports Bar, Gym, Theater
description:
Welcome to The Callahan, a resort-style private retreat in a sought-after neighborhood near top dining, shopping, golf, and hiking. This spacious 5-bedroom, 3-bath home is perfect for families and groups, featuring a private pool, basketball court, putting green, home theater, gym, fire pit, ping pong, and pool table. Enjoy luxury indoor-outdoor living and unforgettable Arizona stays just minutes from the area’s best attractions.

 The space 
Why Guests Love this Place

• Sports Bar
• Pool (optional heating $80/day, 2 day minimum)
• Hot tub
• 5-Hole Putting Green
• Basketball Court
• Ping Pong & Pool Table
• Office
• Gym
• BBQ, Games & More

Backyard

This massive private yard will certainly inspire you to take an endless amount of selfies to send home to your friends and family. The backyard is split up into different areas, including a fire pit with seating for 6, an outdoor dining table with seating for 8, a BBQ and prep island with 3 bar stools, 6 lounge chairs overlooking the pool, a 5-hole putting green, a half basketball court, and a sectional sofa situated next to a 55" TV. So much room for activities. Imagine enjoying a home-cooked meal while watching the beautiful Arizona sunsets. Or maybe you’d prefer to sit in the shade and watch the game while drinking a homemade margarita. How about a competitive game of corn hole or horse in the middle of January. Or maybe you can finally dedicate some time to improving your putting game. After a long day of relaxing by the pool, you’ll likely make your way to the fire pit to share some laughs, watch the stars, and enjoy everything The Callahan has to offer.

• Swimming Pool
• Firepit

Interior

When you first step foot in the door, you’ll be blown away by the vintage boho style interior. Undoubtedly, the next thing you’ll notice are the three 55" TVs in the sports bar. This may be the moment you realize you might not stick to the original plan of touring Tempe and Scottsdale. Instead, you may consider spending every second in this fun-filled dream home. Your group might turn to you and say, your accommodation booking skills have officially landed you the position of booking all future vacations. You crushed it.

Sleeping Arrangements – 5 Bedrooms

All bedrooms are designed to offer the highest possible comfort levels needed to recharge and rest for adventures to come.

• Master Suite 1 - King Bed + Ensuite Bathroom
• Bedroom 2 - King Bed
• Bedroom 3 - King Bed

All bedrooms include:

For your maximum comfort and convenience, there are three bathrooms in the house. All essential toiletries are provided.

• Soaker Tub

Parking:
Street parking available. No access to garage - converted to a theater. 

Location and Proximity to Attractions

Located in a quiet, established residential neighborhood in south Tempe, this home blends peaceful suburban living with easy access to vibrant city life, Arizona State University, outdoor recreation, and major destinations throughout the Valley. Easy access puts the best of the area within reach.

• Nearest Airport: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) — major airport serving domestic and international flights, approximately 10–20 minutes west of Tempe

• Downtown Tempe — lively district with dining, nightlife, entertainment, and events ~10–12 miles, ~20–25 minutes

• Arizona State University and ASU Art Museum — university campus with arts and culture nearby ~4–5 miles, ~8–12 minutes

Parks and Outdoor Attractions

• Tempe Beach Park and Rio Salado Park — lakefront recreation along Tempe Town Lake with walking and biking paths ~5–6 miles, ~10–15 minutes

• Hayden Butte, also known as A Mountain — panoramic views of the lake and city ~5 miles, ~10–12 minutes

• Papago Park — desert park with trails, picnic areas, golf, and scenic rock formations ~7–9 miles, ~12–18 minutes

• Tempe History Museum — exhibits on local history and culture ~3–4 miles, ~8–10 minutes

• Tempe Festival of the Arts — seasonal art festival near the lake ~4–5 miles, ~8–12 minutes

Shopping and Entertainment

• Tempe Marketplace — popular shopping, dining, and entertainment destination near Loop 101 and 202 ~8–10 miles, ~12–18 minutes

Sports and Recreation

• Tempe Diablo Stadium — spring training home of the Los Angeles Angels and host to community events ~4–5 miles, ~8–12 minutes

Major Nearby Cities

• Mesa and Scottsdale — approximately 15–25 minutes with additional dining, entertainment, golf, and cultural attractions

• Downtown Phoenix — approximately 20–30 minutes with museums, sports venues, convention center, and nightlife

Come to relax and enjoy this fun-filled home in Tempe, AZ. We are looking forward to hosting you.

 Guest access 
The house is exclusively yours for the duration of your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home.

 Other things to note 
★ RENTAL CONTRACT★
Full acceptance of the landlord's Rental Contract required within three days of booking acceptance.

★ EARLY CHECK-IN / LATE CHECK-OUT: Check-in is at 4 PM, and check-out is at 10 AM. These times are set to ensure our team has enough time to properly clean, inspect, and prepare the home for each guest.

If you need earlier access or a later departure, the best way to guarantee additional time is to book an extra night before arrival or after departure, subject to availability.

★ POOL HEATING ★
Pool heating is available at $80 per day, 2 day min. Please note that 48-hour advanced notice must be paid before arrival.

Feel free to contact us at any time so we can make the necessary arrangements.

★ PETS ★
This is a pet friendly property. An additional $250 pet fee is required and must be paid 48 hours prior to check in.

★ QUIET HOURS/ NO PARTIES ★
We kindly ask you to respect quiet hours between 9 PM - 8 PM (city ordinance). No music should be played outside during this period, and voices/sounds should be kept low to ensure neighbors are not disturbed.

★ OCCUPANCY ★
the number of guests allowed on the property shall not exceed the number of guests listed in your reservation, whether they are visiting or staying the night.

★ We do not allow any parties to be held at the property at any time of day.

★ Important note: From November to February, pool heat typically warms the water to the mid-70s. Without heating, water temperatures can drop into the 40s or 50s. While we do our best to maintain comfortable pool temperatures, weather conditions may affect the exact temperature.
